problem.symptom: Menu items disappeared when scrolling into the upper-left header region.
problem.rootCause: The header/search controls were laid out above the SingleChildScrollView, so the scroll viewport physically began below the header and content could not travel underneath it.

implementation.approach: Use a full-height scrolling layer inside a Stack with the Pandora header/search controls as a transparent positioned overlay.
implementation.regressionTest: Scroll Guest Experience into the header region, verify it remains geometrically present there, then scroll back down.

coordinator.initialBlockReason: Required status check Pandora coordinator / integration was expected.

durableLessons: For protected Pandora merges, green CI alone is not sufficient when the coordinator check is required; publish a valid coordinator decision and claim the merge fence before external merge transport.
Do not weaken or bypass repository rules to finish a merge; satisfy the coordinator contract, merge the exact verified head, then complete the merge claim and verify main readback.
For transparent fixed sidebar headers, the scroll viewport must extend behind the overlay; moving the scroll boundary or padding the viewport only recreates clipping.
